title: Voucher voided
description: A voucher was voided. `reason` is `REVERSAL` when the redemption that issued it was reversed, or `ERASURE` when the member was erased and its unused vouchers were voided. An `ERASURE` void cut the tie to the member, so `externalRef` is null on it. The event's `aggregate` is `member/<memberId>`. This schema describes the `data` member; the envelope is described in ../../messaging/README.md.

voucherId.description: loyalty's own opaque id for the voucher.

code.description: The single-use voucher code that was voided.

rewardId.description: The reward the voucher was issued for.

redemptionId.description: loyalty's own opaque id for the reward redemption that issued the voucher.

memberId.description: loyalty's own opaque id for the member.

externalRef.description: The Tenant's reference for the member. Null on an `ERASURE` void, because erasure released the reference; set on a `REVERSAL` void.

expiresAt.description: When the voucher would have stopped being usable, in UTC.

reason.description: REVERSAL when the issuing redemption was reversed; ERASURE when the member was erased and its unused vouchers were voided.
